patronOf.en-US: The Lavabo: the priest washes his fingers
patronOf.pt-BR: O Lavabo: o sacerdote lava os dedos

prayerExcerpt.en-US: I will wash my hands among the innocent: and I will compass Thine altar, O Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Lavarei as minhas mãos, como os inocentes, e rodearei, Senhor o vosso altar.

meta.basis: The priest goes to the epistle corner, 'ubi stans, ministro aquam fundente, lavat manus, idest, extremitates digitorum pollicis et indicis, dicens Psalmum: Lavabo inter innocentes' (Ritus servandus VII.6). The psalm stands on the epistle-side altar card (Fortescue, l. 2986–2988). The object card `lavabo` shows the cruet, basin and towel alone; this is the rite.
